quotes.text: This tool brings a potential concern to trained people who can examine the situation properly. That human step protects both the company and the employee.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why human review is central to the tool.

quotes.text: A broad policy with unclear purpose can create far too much review work, while a narrow policy with a clear reason gives reviewers a better chance of finding the items that deserve attention.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear design principle for scoping compliance policies.

quotes.text: A classifier can find a possible concern, but it can't fully understand a relationship, a joke, a quoted customer message, or the history behind a conversation.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Honest statement about the limits of AI classification.

quotes.text: No software setting replaces that planning and remember a policy match is a lead not a verdict.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: It's better to start with a clear, limited purpose, learn from the early results, and refine the policy than to create a huge queue nobody can review properly.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

chapters.title: Where it fits in Microsoft Purview

takeaways: Communication Compliance surfaces possible conduct, data or regulatory concerns in email, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot interactions, but trained people decide what a match means.
Policies should be narrow and purpose-driven, combining sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, keywords, direction and review percentage.
Privacy safeguards such as role-based access, pseudonymization and clear employee notices are as important as detection itself.
hook: Teams chats, emails and Copilot prompts can carry harassment, sensitive data or regulatory risk that nobody notices. This episode explains Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance for compliance, HR and IT teams: how policies, classifiers and human review work together. You learn how to start with one focused, fair policy instead of monitoring everything.
